ios.desc:
If you like card games, you'll love Solitaire Clash! Play classic Klondike Solitaire and join Multiplayer Tournaments to win real money in Cash Matches, or earn in-game items in non-Cash Matches. Download now and put your skills to work in real Cash Matches for an exciting clash of cards!

Download for free! Step into a world of diverse card tournaments with REAL CASH prizes in Cash Matches! We are committed to providing a secure gaming platform built on skill-based competition for all our card players who love to win.

HOW TO PLAY

Sort a 52-card deck by moving cards from the stock to the 7-column tableau, aiming to build all four suits in ascending order. Race against the clock to earn the highest score you can and outperform opponents to win match prizes. Anyone can pick up this simple card game, but it takes real skill to walk away a true Clash champion!

EXPLORE FUN FEATURES

Play Cash Matches, Win Real Money!
-Use Gems to play free matches, or join Cash Matches to win real money. Earn free in-game items daily by logging in and joining various events that make every card clash more rewarding!
 
Compete in Exciting Multiplayer Tournaments
-Play in tournaments with a variety of different match modes, and go head-to-head with multiple other players. The higher you rank, the bigger the money prize you can win! Practice for free before playing real Cash Matches, then choose from a variety of available prize pools to win REAL MONEY and/or in-game items!
 
Enjoy Safe and Secure Withdrawals
-It's safe and easy to withdraw your real money winnings with PayPal. We also work with trusted partners, including Apple Pay, Visa, and American Express (US only), to make every cash deposit and withdrawal smooth and secure.
 
Win Extra In-game Items with Minigames
-Win more in-game rewards through classic mini-games like Scratchers, Dice Cruise, and other fun features that keep your Clash exciting!
 
Enjoy a No-Ads Experience
-Once you start a match, enjoy a truly immersive card gaming experience with no intrusive ads to interrupt your gameplay or your chance to win real money!
 
*Cash Matches are unavailable in the following states: Arkansas, Delaware, Louisiana, Michigan and South Dakota, Maine, Indiana or U.S. territories including Puerto Rico. However, players in these states can still enjoy the fun with free card games!

This game is #1 on the US Casino charts. The description claims "Cashing out your Solitare winnings is easy, safe and secured by PayPal. We also partner with Apple Pay, Visa, Mastercard, and American Express to make the deposit and withdrawal process secure and easier." If this is in fact true, how on earth do they achieve withdrawing real money winnings while adhering to US law? Stranger, the developer seems to be incorporated in the US and raised $40M in funding. https://www.pocket7games.com

It's either magic or Apple is turning an astronomical blind eye to high grossing apps.
